2. WRONG PLACEHOLDER: The Exim string expansion syntax has been corrupted in two places:
   - `tls_resumption_hosts = ${if inlist {$received_port}{587:465} {:}{*}{{{ '{{' }} '{{ '}}' }}' {{ '}}' }}` — the original `${if inlist ...}{*}` ends with `{*{`, which the Jinja2 engine mis-parsed (the `}}` was read as Jinja2 block close, then re-emitted as mangled literal `{{ '{{' }} '{{ '}}' }}' {{ '}}' }}`).
   - `# auth_advertise_hosts = ${if eq {$tls_cipher}{}{}{*{{ '{{' }} '{{ '}}' }}' {{ '}}' }}` — same corruption pattern on the `${if eq ...}{*}` expansion.
   Both `${...}` constructs are Exim's own string expansion language, not configuration values — they must remain verbatim.
